summary: A 300 mm specialty-process foundry line in Beijing, funded by Yandong Micro, Beijing state investors, a BOE affiliate and other funds and controlled by Yandong Micro. Budgeted at CNY 33 billion for 50,000 wafers a month on 28-55nm platforms, it started construction at the end of 2024, began receiving tools in December 2025, and in September 2026 was still commissioning equipment ahead of a mass-production target at the end of 2026.

location.note: Sources place the line in Beijing without naming a site.

metrics.note: About CNY 13 billion beyond the shareholders' equity is to come from bank loans.
Planned 300 mm wafers per month at full capacity, targeted for 2030.

milestones.note: Joint capital increase into the project company disclosed.
A company representative said construction began at the end of 2024.
Move-in ceremony for process tools, starting installation and commissioning; the first-half 2026 report said tool move-in to the main fab building was continuing on schedule.
Mass-production target; the December 2025 company release said the second half of 2026 and the September 2026 report said the end of 2026.

notes: Yandong Micro's 2025 annual report summary says the company had two 300 mm lines planned at 90,000 wafers a month in total and that this project was building its process platforms on schedule. Its first-half 2026 report said key process platforms had reached interim installed-capacity targets and lead products were being prepared for volume production. In September 2026 the company described the line as commissioning tools and ramping capacity, without reporting production; that report was read on 10jqka because the Securities Times original was not found.
